> Split out of the original (4456-line) PR as asked in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46580#issuecomment-6568379129 — this PR is the transformer and text conditioning, **2126 lines**. The pipeline, serving, mask plumbing and cookbook follow in #47831, stacked on this one.

## Motivation

Add the model side of [BRIA Fibo 2.0](https://huggingface.co/briaai/Fibo-2.0-edit-turbo) to SGLang Diffusion. Fibo 2.0 is an 8B flow-matching model that both generates and edits images in the FLUX.2 VAE latent space: Qwen3-VL-4B encodes structured JSON captions, a two-layer Perceiver resamples those features into 256-512 "gist" tokens, and five transformer blocks additionally cross-attend to Qwen3-VL's internal layers.

The weights are released under CC BY-NC 4.0 and require accepting BRIA's license on Hugging Face.

## Modifications

**Model**
- `runtime/models/dits/bria_fibo2.py`: the Fibo 2.0 transformer. It keeps the Z-Image single-stream block and adds a Perceiver resampler, five injection blocks with gated cross-attention, per-token noisy/clean modulation, three-axis RoPE over the gist, image and context-image planes, and patchify/unpatchify around the FLUX.2 latent layout.
- `configs/models/encoders/bria_fibo2.py`: builds the six text bundles from fifteen Qwen3-VL hidden states, each normalized to unit RMS per token before concatenation. The in-tree text tower returns one hidden state per decoder layer, one fewer than the reference, so the reference layer indices are shifted and the tuple length is asserted, which turns a future collection change into an error instead of silently wrong conditioning.
- `configs/models/dits/bria_fibo2.py`: the architecture config, including the checkpoint's own parameter names and the three-axis RoPE geometry.
- Parameter names match the checkpoint one to one (`param_names_mapping` stays empty). q/k/v stay unfused: an injection block reads a 7680-wide text bundle through a 3584-wide query.

**Tests**
- `test/unit/test_bria_fibo2.py` (30 tests): gist-count interpolation, token layout and RoPE planes, per-token modulation, patchify round trips, and the checkpoint key/shape mapping against the released index.
- `test/unit/test_bria_fibo2_encoder.py` (17): the six-bundle construction, the layer shift and its guard, and the architecture fields flattened from the real `text_config` / `vision_config`.
- `test/unit/test_bria_fibo2_parity.py` (3): the transformer against the diffusers implementation at a tiny configuration, for generation, editing and the no-context path.

## Validation

Measured on one H100-80GB with the released `Fibo-2.0-edit-turbo` weights:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Transformer vs diffusers, same weights and inputs, tiny configuration | max abs diff 7e-7, cosine 1.000000000 |
| Full-size transformer, same weights and inputs, 4 Euler steps | final latents cosine 0.999974 |
| Text conditioning vs the reference | six bundles, cosine 0.9868-0.9932 (bf16 drift over 36 layers; feeding either bundle set into the same loop gives the same picture) |
| Parameter mapping | 783/783 checkpoint keys match, no missing, extra or shape mismatch |

`pytest` on the three files: `50 passed`. `pre-commit run --all-files` clean.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Pipeline configuration for BRIA Fibo 2.0.
+
+Fibo 2.0 is text-to-image and image-editing in one model family: the same
+transformer generates a structured-caption image and edits up to five reference
+images, which it conditions on as clean "context" latents. This configuration
+covers the text-to-image path; the editing path (vision side of Qwen3-VL plus
+context latents) plugs into the same classes.
+
+The FLUX.2 VAE the model ships normalizes latents with its own BatchNorm
+statistics rather than a scalar scaling factor. `Flux2PipelineConfig` already
+implements exactly that, so this class inherits it and overrides only what the
+two models do differently:
+
+* latents stay spatial (32 channels) instead of being packed into a sequence,
+* the RoPE table is built inside the transformer, so no position ids are passed,
+* the BatchNorm de-normalization runs inside `preprocess_decoding`, because the
+  decoding stage applies `get_decode_scale_and_shift` *before* it and our latents
+  are only 32 channels wide until the patchify step.
+"""
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Callable, ClassVar, Optional
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models import DiTConfig, EncoderConfig, VAEConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.bria_fibo2 import BriaFibo2DitConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.encoders.base import BaseEncoderOutput
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.encoders.bria_fibo2 import (
+    PROMPT_TEMPLATE_ENCODE,
+    VISION_MARKER,
+    BriaFibo2Qwen3VLConfig,
+    build_caption_bundles,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.vaes.flux import Flux2VAEConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.base import (
+    TextConditioningOutput,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.flux import Flux2PipelineConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.task_type import ModelTaskType
+
+# FLUX's linear shift schedule. Not FLUX.2's empirical formula.
+BASE_IMAGE_SEQ_LEN = 256
+MAX_IMAGE_SEQ_LEN = 4096
+BASE_SHIFT = 0.5
+MAX_SHIFT = 1.15
+
+# The null caption Fibo 2.0 was trained with: every structured-caption key
+# present, every value empty. Only used when guidance is on.
+DEFAULT_NEGATIVE_PROMPT = (
+    '{"short_description":"","objects":[],"background_setting":"","lighting":{},'
+    '"aesthetics":{},"photographic_characteristics":{},"style_medium":"",'
+    '"context":"","artistic_style":""}'
+)
+
+# Structured-caption keys training drops entirely
+DROPPED_CAPTION_KEYS = ("aesthetic_score", "preference_score")
+
+
+def calculate_shift(
+    image_seq_len: int,
+    base_seq_len: int = BASE_IMAGE_SEQ_LEN,
+    max_seq_len: int = MAX_IMAGE_SEQ_LEN,
+    base_shift: float = BASE_SHIFT,
+    max_shift: float = MAX_SHIFT,
+) -> float:
+    """FLUX's linear shift, matching the reference `calculate_shift`."""
+    m = (max_shift - base_shift) / (max_seq_len - base_seq_len)
+    b = base_shift - m * base_seq_len
+    return image_seq_len * m + b
+
+
+def _is_empty(value: Any) -> bool:
+    if isinstance(value, float):
+        return value != value  # NaN
+    return value is None or (isinstance(value, (str, dict, list)) and not value)
+
+
+def _clean_caption(value: Any) -> Any:
+    if isinstance(value, dict):
+        cleaned = {k: _clean_caption(v) for k, v in value.items()}
+        return {k: v for k, v in cleaned.items() if not _is_empty(v)}
+    if isinstance(value, list):
+        return [v for v in map(_clean_caption, value) if not _is_empty(v)]
+    return value
+
+
+def parse_caption_prompt(prompt: str) -> tuple[Any, Optional[str]]:
+    """Split a prompt into its structured caption and its edit instruction.
+
+    Mirrors the reference `_parse_prompt`: a prompt that is not a JSON object is
+    returned as-is with no instruction. A caption is cleaned the way training
+    cleaned captions - empty values and the two score fields are dropped - and a
+    caption of exactly ``short_description`` plus ``text_render`` keeps both keys
+    in that order, with the list even when empty (it says the image has no text).
+    """
+    try:
+        import json
+
+        caption = json.loads(prompt)
+    except Exception:
+        return prompt, None
+    if not isinstance(caption, dict):
+        return prompt, None
+
+    instruction = caption.pop("edit_instruction", None)
+    if "structured_caption" in caption:
+        caption = caption.pop("structured_caption")
+        if not isinstance(caption, dict):
+            return caption or None, instruction
+
+    keys = set(caption)
+    cleaned = _clean_caption(caption)
+    caption = {}
+    for key, value in cleaned.items():
+        if key in DROPPED_CAPTION_KEYS:
+            continue
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            value = {k: v for k, v in value.items() if k not in DROPPED_CAPTION_KEYS}
+        if value == {}:
+            continue
+        caption[key] = value
+
+    if keys == {"short_description", "text_render"}:
+        caption = {
+            "short_description": caption.get("short_description") or "",
+            "text_render": caption.get("text_render") or [],
+        }
+    return caption or None, instruction
+
+
+def serialize_caption(caption: Any) -> str:
+    """Compact JSON, keeping non-ASCII characters as they are."""
+    import json
+
+    return json.dumps(caption, separators=(",", ":"), ensure_ascii=False)
+
+
+def normalize_prompt(prompt: str) -> str:
+    """Put a generation caption in the trained form, compactly serialized.
+
+    A prompt that is not a JSON caption, such as a short description, is left
+    untouched.
+    """
+    caption, _ = parse_caption_prompt(prompt)
+    if isinstance(caption, str):
+        return prompt
+    return serialize_caption(caption or {})
+
+
+def render_prompt(
+    prompt: str, prompt_template_encode: str = PROMPT_TEMPLATE_ENCODE
+) -> str:
+    """Normalize a caption, then wrap it in the Qwen3-VL chat turn."""
+    return prompt_template_encode.format(normalize_prompt(prompt))
+
+
+def bria_fibo2_preprocess_text(prompt: str) -> str:
+    """Module-level default; the pipeline config binds the arch config's template."""
+    return render_prompt(prompt)
+
+
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+# Editing: prompt assembly, mask handling and image sizing
+# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
+
+
+def build_edit_prompt(prompt: str, num_images: int) -> str:
+    """Assemble the JSON edit prompt Qwen3-VL sees, one marker per image.
+
+    The reference builds one JSON object: a vision marker per image to edit, the
+    caption of the result when the prompt carries one, then the edit
+    instruction. A prompt that is not JSON is the instruction alone.
+    """
+    if num_images < 1:
+        raise ValueError(f"an edit needs at least one image, got {num_images}")
+
+    caption, instruction = parse_caption_prompt(prompt)
+    if instruction is None:
+        # the whole prompt is the instruction
+        caption, instruction = None, prompt
+
+    edit: dict[str, Any] = {}
+    if num_images == 1:
+        edit["image"] = VISION_MARKER
+    else:
+        for k in range(1, num_images + 1):
+            edit[f"image_{k}"] = VISION_MARKER
+    if caption:
+        edit["structured_caption"] = caption
+    edit["edit_instruction"] = instruction
+    return serialize_caption(edit)
+
+
+def apply_mask_to_image(image: Any, mask: Any) -> Any:
+    """Grey out the region the mask marks before the image is resized.
+
+    The mask is white where the model should repaint; that region is replaced
+    with flat grey ``(128, 128, 128)`` on the *original* image, matching how
+    training prepared edit pairs. The mask therefore never reaches the
+    transformer: the generator learns the region from the greying itself.
+    """
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    if mask.size != image.size:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"mask size {mask.size} does not match image size {image.size}"
+        )
+
+    # white (>= 128) marks the region to regenerate
+    binary = mask.convert("L").point(lambda value: 255 if value >= 128 else 0)
+
+    image = image.convert("RGB")
+    grey = Image.new("RGB", image.size, (128, 128, 128))
+    return Image.composite(grey, image, binary)
+
+
+def get_image_size(
+    aspect_ratio: float,
+    area: int = 1024 * 1024,
+    multiple_of: int = 16,
+    min_side: int = 64,
+    tolerance: float = 0.1,
+) -> tuple[int, int]:
+    """Pick a trained-resolution canvas for an aspect ratio, about ``area``.
+
+    Candidates are multiples of ``multiple_of`` with both sides at least
+    ``min_side`` and an area within ``tolerance`` of ``area``. The reference
+    prefers the canvas that crops the input the least, then the one whose area is
+    closest, then the wider one. Returns ``(width, height)``.
+    """
+    if aspect_ratio <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(f"aspect ratio must be positive, got {aspect_ratio}")
+
+    target_area = area
+    low, high = target_area * (1.0 - tolerance), target_area * (1.0 + tolerance)
+
+    best = None
+    # Walk the width axis in multiples; derive the height from the ratio.
+    width = multiple_of
+    while width * width / max(aspect_ratio, 1e-9) <= high * 4:
+        height = int(round(width / aspect_ratio))
+        height = (height // multiple_of) * multiple_of or multiple_of
+        if height < min_side:
+            width += multiple_of
+            continue
+        candidate_area = width * height
+        if candidate_area < low:
+            width += multiple_of
+            continue
+        if candidate_area > high:
+            break
+
+        # how much of the input this canvas has to crop
+        crop_ratio = 1.0 - min(
+            (width / height) / aspect_ratio, aspect_ratio / (width / height)
+        )
+        key = (round(crop_ratio, 6), abs(candidate_area - target_area), -width)
+        if best is None or key < best[0]:
+            best = (key, (width, height))
+        width += multiple_of
+
+    if best is None:
+        # No candidate inside the band (extreme aspect ratio): fall back to the
+        # nearest multiple pair for the target area.
+        width = int(round(math.sqrt(target_area * aspect_ratio)))
+        width = max(min_side, (width // multiple_of) * multiple_of or multiple_of)
+        height = int(round(width / aspect_ratio))
+        height = max(min_side, (height // multiple_of) * multiple_of or multiple_of)
+        return width, height
+
+    return best[1]
+
+
+def crop_to_size(image: Any, width: int, height: int) -> Any:
+    """Scale then centre-crop to the target canvas, the reference resize mode."""
+    from PIL import Image
+
+    scale = max(width / image.width, height / image.height)
+    resized_size = (
+        max(1, int(round(image.width * scale))),
+        max(1, int(round(image.height * scale))),
+    )
+    resized = image.resize(resized_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
+    left = (resized.width - width) // 2
+    top = (resized.height - height) // 2
+    return resized.crop((left, top, left + width, top + height))
+
+
+def make_text_encoder_copy(image: Any, max_side: int = 768) -> Any:
+    """The copy Qwen3-VL sees: the cropped image, shrunk to ``max_side``."""
+    copy = image.copy()
+    copy.thumbnail((max_side, max_side))
+    return copy
+
+
+def bria_fibo2_postprocess_text(
+    outputs: BaseEncoderOutput,
+    text_inputs: Any,
+    pipeline_config: Any = None,
+) -> TextConditioningOutput:
+    """Turn the text tower's hidden states into the transformer's six bundles."""
+    hidden_states = outputs.hidden_states
+    if hidden_states is None:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BriaFibo2 needs the text encoder's hidden states; the encoder was "
+            "called without `output_hidden_states=True`."
+        )
+
+    if pipeline_config is not None:
+        arch_config = pipeline_config.text_encoder_configs[0].arch_config
+        num_hidden_layers = int(arch_config.num_hidden_layers)
+    else:
+        # Without the config, fall back to the tower's own length: the bundle
+        # builder still validates it against the offset.
+        num_hidden_layers = len(hidden_states)
+
+    bundles = build_caption_bundles(hidden_states, num_hidden_layers)
+
+    attention_mask = text_inputs["attention_mask"].bool()
+    seq_lens = [int(m.sum().item()) for m in attention_mask]
+    return TextConditioningOutput(
+        prompt_embeds=bundles,
+        prompt_embeds_mask=attention_mask,
+        prompt_seq_lens=seq_lens,
+    )
+
+
+def prepare_mu(batch: Any, server_args: Any) -> tuple[str, float]:
+    """Shift for the denoising schedule, from the image token count."""
+    pipeline_config = server_args.pipeline_config
+    vae_scale_factor = pipeline_config.get_vae_scale_factor()
+    patch_size = pipeline_config.dit_config.arch_config.patch_size
+    height_tokens = (int(batch.height) // vae_scale_factor) // patch_size
+    width_tokens = (int(batch.width) // vae_scale_factor) // patch_size
+    image_seq_len = height_tokens * width_tokens
+    return "mu", calculate_shift(image_seq_len)
+
+
+# The FLUX.2 VAE config carries its BatchNorm epsilon only when loaded from the
+# checkpoint; the reference default is 1e-4.
+DEFAULT_BATCH_NORM_EPS = 1e-4
+
+# The released checkpoints all ship a 8x FLUX.2 VAE (block_out_channels
+# [128, 256, 512, 512]); only used before the checkpoint config has been read.
+FLUX2_DEFAULT_VAE_SCALE_FACTOR = 8
+
+
+@dataclass
+class BriaFibo2PipelineConfig(Flux2PipelineConfig):
+    # One model family serves text-to-image and editing. The text-to-image path
+    # runs on its own; editing adds the vision side of Qwen3-VL and the reference
+    # latents, and is driven by `BriaFibo2EditPipeline`.
+    task_type: ModelTaskType = ModelTaskType.T2I
+    supported_task_types: ClassVar[tuple[ModelTaskType, ...]] = (
+        ModelTaskType.T2I,
+        ModelTaskType.I2I,
+        ModelTaskType.TI2I,
+    )
+
+    dit_config: DiTConfig = field(default_factory=BriaFibo2DitConfig)
+    vae_config: VAEConfig = field(default_factory=Flux2VAEConfig)
+
+    # The transformer has no guidance embedding: classifier-free guidance is a
+    # second forward pass, which the reference only runs for the dev checkpoint.
+    should_use_guidance: bool = False
+
+    text_encoder_configs: tuple[EncoderConfig, ...] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: (BriaFibo2Qwen3VLConfig(),)
+    )
+    text_encoder_precisions: tuple[str, ...] = field(default_factory=lambda: ("bf16",))
+    vae_precision: str = "bf16"
+
+    preprocess_text_funcs: tuple[Callable, ...] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: (bria_fibo2_preprocess_text,)
+    )
+    postprocess_text_funcs: tuple[Callable, ...] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: (bria_fibo2_postprocess_text,)
+    )
+
+    default_negative_prompt: str = DEFAULT_NEGATIVE_PROMPT
+    # Output size defaults, mirroring the reference: 128 latent pixels, 8x VAE
+    default_sample_size: int = 128
+    tokenizer_max_length: int = 4096
+    # Qwen3-VL sees each image at no more than this long side
+    text_encoder_image_size: int = 768
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Flux2's Mistral-specific tokenizer extras do not apply here. The base
+        # dataclasses define no `__post_init__`, so nothing is chained.
+        self.text_encoder_extra_args = [
+            dict(
+                max_length=self.tokenizer_max_length,
+                padding="longest",
+                truncation=True,
+                return_tensors="pt",
+            )
+        ]
+        # One definition, one consumption: the template lives on the encoder arch
+        # config, and both the prompt rendering and the pipeline read it from
+        # there rather than repeating the literal.
+        self.prompt_template_encode = self.text_encoder_configs[
+            0
+        ].arch_config.prompt_template_encode
+        self.preprocess_text_funcs = (self.preprocess_text,)
+

Good catch — the mask was dead code, and the root cause is exactly what you describe: `InputValidationStage` calls `preprocess_condition_image` per image without the batch, so `getattr(batch, "mask", None)` could never see a request.

Fixed in the two commits on top. `preprocess_vae_image` is the hook that does receive the batch, and `InputValidationStage` runs it *before* the crop loop, so the greying now happens on the original image in the order training used:

- `[Feat] diffusion: plumb an optional repaint mask through the image edits API` — `POST /v1/images/edits` declared `mask` and dropped it; it is now saved and forwarded as `SamplingParams.mask_path` (per-request, like `image_path`), so a masked edit no longer silently degrades to a plain edit.
- `[Fix] diffusion/bria_fibo2: apply the request mask to the source image` — the greying moved to `preprocess_vae_image`; `preprocess_condition_image` is crop-only again. A mask with several reference images, or one whose size differs from its image, raises instead of being composited wrong. One detail only the real run surfaced: the hook has to leave `condition_image` as a list, because the stage iterates it immediately afterwards.

Verified on an H100 with the same inputs as the reference run (suitcase + mask, 4 steps, guidance 1.0): mean absolute change is **0.254 inside the mask vs 0.008 outside**, against the reference's 0.248 / 0.008 — the edit stays in the marked region and the rest is preserved. Locally: `184 passed, 3 skipped` across the five new test files plus the sampling-params / image-API suites, and `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs` 52/52.

detail.body:
> Split out of the original (4456-line) PR as asked in https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46580#issuecomment-6568379129 — this PR is the transformer and text conditioning, **2126 lines**. The pipeline, serving, mask plumbing and cookbook follow in #47831, stacked on this one.

## Motivation

Add the model side of [BRIA Fibo 2.0](https://huggingface.co/briaai/Fibo-2.0-edit-turbo) to SGLang Diffusion. Fibo 2.0 is an 8B flow-matching model that both generates and edits images in the FLUX.2 VAE latent space: Qwen3-VL-4B encodes structured JSON captions, a two-layer Perceiver resamples those features into 256-512 "gist" tokens, and five transformer blocks additionally cross-attend to Qwen3-VL's internal layers.

The weights are released under CC BY-NC 4.0 and require accepting BRIA's license on Hugging Face.

## Modifications

**Model**
- `runtime/models/dits/bria_fibo2.py`: the Fibo 2.0 transformer. It keeps the Z-Image single-stream block and adds a Perceiver resampler, five injection blocks with gated cross-attention, per-token noisy/clean modulation, three-axis RoPE over the gist, image and context-image planes, and patchify/unpatchify around the FLUX.2 latent layout.
- `configs/models/encoders/bria_fibo2.py`: builds the six text bundles from fifteen Qwen3-VL hidden states, each normalized to unit RMS per token before concatenation. The in-tree text tower returns one hidden state per decoder layer, one fewer than the reference, so the reference layer indices are shifted and the tuple length is asserted, which turns a future collection change into an error instead of silently wrong conditioning.
- `configs/models/dits/bria_fibo2.py`: the architecture config, including the checkpoint's own parameter names and the three-axis RoPE geometry.
- Parameter names match the checkpoint one to one (`param_names_mapping` stays empty). q/k/v stay unfused: an injection block reads a 7680-wide text bundle through a 3584-wide query.

**Tests**
- `test/unit/test_bria_fibo2.py` (30 tests): gist-count interpolation, token layout and RoPE planes, per-token modulation, patchify round trips, and the checkpoint key/shape mapping against the released index.
- `test/unit/test_bria_fibo2_encoder.py` (17): the six-bundle construction, the layer shift and its guard, and the architecture fields flattened from the real `text_config` / `vision_config`.
- `test/unit/test_bria_fibo2_parity.py` (3): the transformer against the diffusers implementation at a tiny configuration, for generation, editing and the no-context path.

## Validation

Measured on one H100-80GB with the released `Fibo-2.0-edit-turbo` weights:

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Transformer vs diffusers, same weights and inputs, tiny configuration | max abs diff 7e-7, cosine 1.000000000 |
| Full-size transformer, same weights and inputs, 4 Euler steps | final latents cosine 0.999974 |
| Text conditioning vs the reference | six bundles, cosine 0.9868-0.9932 (bf16 drift over 36 layers; feeding either bundle set into the same loop gives the same picture) |
| Parameter mapping | 783/783 checkpoint keys match, no missing, extra or shape mismatch |

`pytest` on the three files: `50 passed`. `pre-commit run --all-files` clean.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Architecture configuration for the BRIA Fibo 2.0 diffusion transformer.
+
+Fibo 2.0 keeps the Z-Image transformer block and adds three things on top of it:
+
+* a Perceiver resampler that squeezes the text encoder features into a variable
+  number of "gist" tokens,
+* five injection blocks that also cross-attend to their own text bundle,
+* per-token (noisy/clean) adaLN modulation, which is how editing conditions the
+  generation on the clean latents of the images to edit.
+
+The parameter names emitted here are the checkpoint's own diffusers names
+(``attention.to_q``, ``attention.to_out.0``, ``cross_attn_gate``,
+``perceiver.latent_queries``, ...). The runtime model mirrors them one to one, so
+``param_names_mapping`` stays empty and no weight reshuffle happens at load time.
+In particular q/k/v are kept separate: a cross-attention block reads a
+``cap_feat_dim`` (7680) wide text bundle while its query comes from a ``dim``
+(3584) wide stream, so the two cannot be fused into one stacked projection.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Tuple
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.base import DiTArchConfig, DiTConfig
+
+
+@dataclass
+class BriaFibo2ArchConfig(DiTArchConfig):
+    # 2x2 latent patches become one token, features ordered (channel, dy, dx)
+    all_patch_size: Tuple[int, ...] = (2,)
+    patch_size: int = 2
+    in_channels: int = 32
+    out_channels: int | None = None
+
+    dim: int = 3584
+    num_layers: int = 44
+    n_refiner_layers: int = 2
+    num_attention_heads: int = 28
+    norm_eps: float = 1e-5
+
+    # Text conditioning: 3 Qwen3-VL layers of 2560 channels concatenated
+    cap_feat_dim: int = 7680
+    # Blocks that cross-attend to their own text bundle. Bundle 0 feeds the
+    # Perceiver, bundle k + 1 feeds injection_layer_ids[k].
+    injection_layer_ids: Tuple[int, ...] = (6, 14, 22, 30, 38)
+    perceiver_num_layers: int = 2
+
+    # Gist token count: interpolated from the text length, quantized to a step
+    min_num_gist_tokens: int = 256
+    max_num_gist_tokens: int = 512
+    gist_step: int = 64
+    gist_min_text_len: int = 256
+    gist_max_text_len: int = 2048
+
+    rope_theta: float = 256.0
+    t_scale: float = 1000.0
+    # The diffusion stages hand the transformer the scheduler's own timesteps
+    # (0..num_train_timesteps), while the reference transformer takes the noise
+    # level in [0, 1] and multiplies by `t_scale` itself. Dividing by the
+    # scheduler's unit count bridges the two conventions without touching the
+    # embedding domain the checkpoint was trained in.
+    scheduler_timesteps: float = 1000.0
+    # Three axes (plane, row, column); the sum is the attention head dim
+    axes_dims: Tuple[int, int, int] = (32, 48, 48)
+    axes_lens: Tuple[int, int, int] = (2048, 512, 512)
+
+    # Fibo keeps q/k/v separate (see module docstring), so nothing is stacked
+    stacked_params_mapping: list[tuple[str, str, str]] = field(default_factory=list)
+
+    # diffusers names are used as-is by the runtime model
+    param_names_mapping: dict = field(default_factory=dict)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        super().__post_init__()
+        self.out_channels = self.out_channels or self.in_channels
+        self.num_channels_latents = self.in_channels
+        self.hidden_size = self.dim
+        self.num_attention_heads = self.num_attention_heads
+        if sum(self.axes_dims) != self.dim // self.num_attention_heads:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "axes_dims must sum to the attention head dim: "
+                f"sum({self.axes_dims}) != {self.dim} // {self.num_attention_heads}"
+            )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class BriaFibo2DitConfig(DiTConfig):
+    arch_config: BriaFibo2ArchConfig = field(default_factory=BriaFibo2ArchConfig)
+
+    prefix: str = "bria_fibo2"
+
+    # One block serves the gist tokens (hundreds) and the image plus context
+    # tokens (thousands); the gist branch is the short one, so its GEMMs should
+    # not be autotuned for the long shape alone.
+    torch_compile_inductor_config: dict[str, Any] = field(
+        default_factory=lambda: {"multi_kernel_hints": [512, 4096]}
+    )
+
+
+__all__ = ["BriaFibo2ArchConfig", "BriaFibo2DitConfig"]

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Qwen3-VL text encoder configuration for BRIA Fibo 2.0.
+
+Fibo 2.0 conditions its transformer on six "caption bundles", each made of three
+Qwen3-VL hidden states concatenated along the channel axis after a per-token
+float32 RMS normalization. Bundle 0 feeds the Perceiver resampler, bundles 1..5
+feed the injection blocks in order.
+
+Two things here are easy to get silently wrong, so both are asserted:
+
+* **Layer index semantics.** The reference indexes the ``output_hidden_states``
+  tuple the way ``transformers`` builds it: index 0 is the embedding output and
+  index ``i`` is the input of decoder layer ``i``, for ``n_layers + 1`` entries.
+  The in-tree Qwen3-VL text tower instead appends *after* each layer and never
+  appends the final norm, so it yields ``n_layers`` entries where entry ``i`` is
+  the output of layer ``i``. Hence ``sglang[i] == hf[i + 1]`` and the reference
+  indices must be shifted down by one. ``SGLANG_HIDDEN_STATE_OFFSET`` records
+  that, and the length assertion turns any upstream change into an error instead
+  of wrong weights.
+* **Architecture defaults.** The inherited defaults describe Qwen3-VL-8B, not the
+  4B variant Fibo ships. ``post_diffusers_config_update`` flattens the real
+  per-component values out of ``text_config`` / ``vision_config`` rather than
+  relying on any default.
+"""
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any, Sequence
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.encoders.base import (
+    TextEncoderArchConfig,
+    TextEncoderConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.encoders.qwen3vl import Qwen3VLArchConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.fsdp import (
+    is_block,
+    is_embed_tokens,
+    is_final_norm,
+    is_layer,
+)
+
+# Qwen3-VL layers behind the transformer's six text inputs, in `transformers`
+# index space: the Perceiver's bundle first, then one bundle per injection block
+# (injection_layer_ids = (6, 14, 22, 30, 38)).
+TEXT_ENCODER_OUT_LAYERS: tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...] = (
+    (9, 20, 31),
+    (5, 16, 27),
+    (7, 18, 29),
+    (9, 20, 31),
+    (11, 22, 33),
+    (13, 24, 35),
+)
+
+# The in-tree text tower drains decoder-layer outputs only, so its tuple is one
+# entry shorter and every reference index maps one lower. Never drop this shift.
+SGLANG_HIDDEN_STATE_OFFSET = 1
+
+PROMPT_TEMPLATE_ENCODE = "<|im_start|>user\n{}<|im_end|>\n<|im_start|>assistant\n"
+
+VISION_MARKER = "<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>"
+
+CAP_FEAT_DIM = 7680
+
+
+def unique_hf_layers(
+    out_layers: Sequence[Sequence[int]] = TEXT_ENCODER_OUT_LAYERS,
+) -> list[int]:
+    """The distinct reference layer indices, sorted."""
+    return sorted({layer for bundle in out_layers for layer in bundle})
+
+
+def sglang_layer_indices(
+    out_layers: Sequence[Sequence[int]] = TEXT_ENCODER_OUT_LAYERS,
+) -> tuple[tuple[int, ...], ...]:
+    """Reference layer indices translated into the in-tree tower's tuple."""
+    return tuple(
+        tuple(layer - SGLANG_HIDDEN_STATE_OFFSET for layer in bundle)
+        for bundle in out_layers
+    )
+
+
+def build_caption_bundles(
+    hidden_states: Sequence[torch.Tensor],
+    num_hidden_layers: int,
+    dtype: torch.dtype | None = None,
+    out_layers: Sequence[Sequence[int]] = TEXT_ENCODER_OUT_LAYERS,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Stack the six caption bundles from the text tower's hidden states.
+
+    Args:
+        hidden_states: the text tower's ``output_hidden_states`` tuple, in the
+            in-tree convention (outputs of every decoder layer, no embedding or
+            final-norm entry), length ``num_hidden_layers``.
+        num_hidden_layers: layer count the tower was built with, used to check
+            the tuple length so an upstream collection change fails loudly.
+        dtype: dtype the normalized states are cast back to; defaults to the
+            dtype of the input states.
+
+    Returns:
+        ``(batch, 6, text_len, 3 * hidden_size)``, i.e. ``(B, 6, T, 7680)`` for
+        the released checkpoints.
+    """
+    if len(hidden_states) != num_hidden_layers:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "BriaFibo2 expects the text tower to return one hidden state per "
+            f"decoder layer ({num_hidden_layers}), got {len(hidden_states)}. "
+            "Changing how Qwen3-VL collects `all_hidden_states` changes the "
+            f"layer mapping (currently offset {SGLANG_HIDDEN_STATE_OFFSET})."
+        )
+
+    target_dtype = dtype if dtype is not None else hidden_states[0].dtype
+    normalized: dict[int, torch.Tensor] = {}
+    for hf_layer in unique_hf_layers(out_layers):
+        index = hf_layer - SGLANG_HIDDEN_STATE_OFFSET
+        states = hidden_states[index].float()
+        # unit RMS per token, matching the reference
+        normalized[hf_layer] = (
+            states * torch.rsqrt(states.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+        ).to(target_dtype)
+
+    bundles = [
+        torch.cat([normalized[layer] for layer in bundle], dim=-1)
+        for bundle in out_layers
+    ]
+    return torch.stack(bundles, dim=1)
+
+

+    """Read a field from either a config object or a plain dict."""
+    if container is None:
+        return default
+    if isinstance(container, dict):
+        return container.get(key, default)
+    return getattr(container, key, default)
+

+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        # Deliberately not calling super().__post_init__(): `Qwen3VLArchConfig`
+        # installs JoyImage's tokenizer kwargs there, whose `max_length` is
+        # `text_len + prompt_template_encode_start_idx["image"]` (34 extra
+        # tokens). Fibo's template is a plain chat turn with no such offset, so
+        # the inherited value would silently mis-size every prompt.
+        self.tokenizer_kwargs = {

+            "truncation": True,

+        }

+        """Flatten the real encoder shape out of the checkpoint config.
+
+        `update_model_arch` copies only top-level keys, so the nested

+        """
+        arch = self.arch_config

+        text_config = _read(arch, "text_config")
+        vision_config = _read(arch, "vision_config")

+
+A single-stream DiT in the Z-Image family, extended in three ways:
+
+* a Perceiver resampler turns the first text bundle into ``num_gist_tokens``
+  gist tokens, a count derived per prompt from the text length,
+* the blocks listed in ``injection_layer_ids`` also cross-attend to their own
+  text bundle,
+* adaLN modulation is per token: tokens marked noisy by ``noise_mask`` take the
+  modulation of the real timestep, the others (gist and context tokens, which
+  are clean) take the modulation of t = 0. That is how editing conditions a
+  generation on the clean latents of the images to edit.
+
+The whole image plus every context image share one sequence and one patch
+embedding. Their positions come from a three-axis RoPE, so the token order only
+affects float rounding, not the result.
+
+Parameter names are the checkpoint's diffusers names, so weights load without a
+remap. q/k/v and w1/w3 are deliberately kept as separate projections: a
+cross-attention reads a ``cap_feat_dim`` wide text bundle with a ``dim`` wide
+query, so those cannot share a stacked projection.
+
+This file targets the single-GPU path. Tensor/sequence parallelism, an
+attention-backend switch (the reference uses ``USPAttention`` elsewhere in the
+tree) and the batched variable-gist path are follow-ups; the batched case is
+rejected explicitly rather than half-supported.
+"""
+

+
+import math
+from typing import Any, Optional, Sequence, Tuple
+
+import torch
+import torch.nn as nn
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+

+def compute_gist_count(
+    text_lengths: Sequence[int],
+    min_gist: int,
+    max_gist: int,
+    gist_step: int,
+    min_text_len: int,
+    max_text_len: int,
+) -> list[int]:
+    """Number of gist tokens per prompt, from its text length in tokens.
+
+    Lengths between ``min_text_len`` and ``max_text_len`` map linearly onto
+    ``[min_gist, max_gist]``, rounded up to a multiple of ``gist_step``.
+    """
+    span = max_text_len - min_text_len
+    counts = []
+    for n in text_lengths:
+        ratio = min(1.0, max(0.0, (float(n) - min_text_len) / span))
+        raw = min_gist + ratio * (max_gist - min_gist)
+        quantized = int(math.ceil(raw / gist_step)) * gist_step
+        counts.append(max(min_gist, min(max_gist, quantized)))
+    return counts
+

+class BriaFibo2RMSNorm(nn.Module):
+    """RMSNorm matching the reference implementation.
+
+    The variance is taken in float32. ``zimage.ZImageRMSNorm`` deliberately keeps
+    Z-Image's native bf16 behaviour instead, so the two are not interchangeable.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, eps: float = 1e-5) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(dim))
+        self.variance_epsilon = eps
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        input_dtype = x.dtype
+        x_float = x.to(torch.float32)
+        variance = x_float.pow(2).mean(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
+        normalized = x_float * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.variance_epsilon)
+        return self.weight * normalized.to(input_dtype)
+

+def _mask_to_bool(mask: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """SDPA wants a bool (or float) mask; the stages carry it as long/bool."""
+    if mask.dtype == torch.bool:
+        return mask
+    if mask.is_floating_point():
+        return mask
+    return mask != 0
+
+
+def normalize_encoder_attention_mask(
+    mask: Any, device: torch.device
+) -> Optional[torch.Tensor]:
+    """Normalize the text mask to one ``(batch, text_len)`` tensor.
+
+    The diffusion stages thread prompt masks **per sample** (`Req.prompt_attention_mask`
+    is a list), which is convenient for the encoders but not for the transformer;
+    accept either form so the caller does not have to convert.
+    """
+    if mask is None:
+        return None
+    if isinstance(mask, torch.Tensor):
+        mask = mask if mask.device == device else mask.to(device)
+        return _mask_to_bool(mask)
+    if isinstance(mask, (list, tuple)):
+        items = [m for m in mask if m is not None]
+        if not items or len(items) != len(mask):
+            return None
+        tensors = [
+            _mask_to_bool(
+                (m if isinstance(m, torch.Tensor) else torch.as_tensor(m)).to(device)
+            )
+            for m in items
+        ]
+        if len(tensors) == 1:
+            single = tensors[0]
+            return single if single.dim() == 2 else single.reshape(1, -1)
+        if all(t.dim() == 2 and t.shape[0] == 1 for t in tensors):
+            return torch.cat(tensors, dim=0)
+        return torch.stack(tensors, dim=0)
+    return None
+

+def select_per_token(
+    value_noisy: torch.Tensor,
+    value_clean: torch.Tensor,
+    noise_mask: torch.Tensor,
+    seq_len: int,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Broadcast the noisy or the clean value onto each token of the sequence."""
+    noise_mask_expanded = noise_mask.unsqueeze(-1)  # (batch, seq_len, 1)
+    return torch.where(
+        noise_mask_expanded == 1,
+        value_noisy.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, seq_len, -1),
+        value_clean.unsqueeze(1).expand(-1, seq_len, -1),
+    )
+

+def apply_rotary_emb(
+    x: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Rotate adjacent channel pairs, the complex multiply of the reference.
+
+    ``x`` is ``[batch, seq_len, heads, head_dim]``; ``cos`` and ``sin`` are
+    ``[1, seq_len, head_dim // 2]``. The rotation is computed in float32 and cast
+    back, as the reference does.
+    """
+    dtype = x.dtype
+    x_float = x.float()
+    x_even = x_float[..., 0::2]
+    x_odd = x_float[..., 1::2]
+    cos = cos.unsqueeze(2).float()
+    sin = sin.unsqueeze(2).float()
+    out_even = x_even * cos - x_odd * sin
+    out_odd = x_even * sin + x_odd * cos
+    return torch.stack((out_even, out_odd), dim=-1).flatten(-2).to(dtype)
+

+class BriaFibo2TimestepEmbedder(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        out_size: int,
+        mid_size: Optional[int] = None,
+        frequency_embedding_size: int = 256,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        if mid_size is None:
+            mid_size = out_size
+        self.mlp = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(frequency_embedding_size, mid_size, bias=True),
+            nn.SiLU(),
+            nn.Linear(mid_size, out_size, bias=True),
+        )
+        self.frequency_embedding_size = frequency_embedding_size
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def timestep_embedding(
+        t: torch.Tensor, dim: int, max_period: int = 10000
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        half = dim // 2
+        freqs = torch.exp(
+            -math.log(max_period)
+            * torch.arange(start=0, end=half, dtype=torch.float32, device=t.device)
+            / half
+        )
+        args = t[:, None].float() * freqs[None]
+        embedding = torch.cat([torch.cos(args), torch.sin(args)], dim=-1)
+        if dim % 2:
+            embedding = torch.cat(
+                [embedding, torch.zeros_like(embedding[:, :1])], dim=-1
+            )
+        return embedding
+
+    def forward(self, t: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        t_freq = self.timestep_embedding(t, self.frequency_embedding_size)
+        return self.mlp(t_freq.to(self.mlp[0].weight.dtype))
+

+class BriaFibo2FeedForward(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, dim: int, hidden_dim: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.w1 = nn.Linear(dim, hidden_dim, bias=False)
+        self.w2 = nn.Linear(hidden_dim, dim, bias=False)
+        self.w3 = nn.Linear(dim, hidden_dim, bias=False)
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return self.w2(F.silu(self.w1(x)) * self.w3(x))

+class BriaFibo2Attention(nn.Module):
+    """Self-attention (with RoPE) or cross-attention to ``encoder_hidden_states``."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        query_dim: int,
+        heads: int,
+        dim_head: int,
+        kv_dim: Optional[int] = None,
+        eps: float = 1e-5,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.heads = heads
+        self.head_dim = dim_head
+        kv_dim = kv_dim or query_dim
+        self.to_q = nn.Linear(query_dim, heads * dim_head, bias=False)
+        self.to_k = nn.Linear(kv_dim, heads * dim_head, bias=False)
+        self.to_v = nn.Linear(kv_dim, heads * dim_head, bias=False)
+        # The reference keeps the output projection in a ModuleList, which the
+        # checkpoint reflects as `to_out.0`
+        self.to_out = nn.ModuleList(
+            [nn.Linear(heads * dim_head, query_dim, bias=False)]
+        )
+        self.norm_q = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim_head, eps=eps)
+        self.norm_k = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim_head, eps=eps)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        encoder_hidden_states: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        freqs_cis: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch_size, seq_len = hidden_states.shape[0], hidden_states.shape[1]
+        query = self.to_q(hidden_states)
+        kv_source = (
+            hidden_states if encoder_hidden_states is None else encoder_hidden_states
+        )
+        key = self.to_k(kv_source)
+        value = self.to_v(kv_source)
+
+        query = query.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.heads, self.head_dim)
+        key = key.view(batch_size, -1, self.heads, self.head_dim)
+        value = value.view(batch_size, -1, self.heads, self.head_dim)
+
+        query = self.norm_q(query)
+        key = self.norm_k(key)
+
+        if freqs_cis is not None:
+            cos, sin = freqs_cis
+            query = apply_rotary_emb(query, cos, sin)
+            key = apply_rotary_emb(key, cos, sin)
+
+        query = query.transpose(1, 2)
+        key = key.transpose(1, 2)
+        value = value.transpose(1, 2)
+
+        # A 2D mask marks the real keys, so it broadcasts over query and heads
+        if attention_mask is not None and attention_mask.ndim == 2:
+            attention_mask = attention_mask[:, None, None, :]
+
+        out = F.scaled_dot_product_attention(
+            query,
+            key,
+            value,
+            attn_mask=attention_mask,
+            dropout_p=0.0,
+            is_causal=False,
+        )
+        out = out.transpose(1, 2).reshape(batch_size, seq_len, -1)
+        return self.to_out[0](out)
+

+class BriaFibo2TransformerBlock(nn.Module):
+    """A Z-Image block, plus optional text cross-attention and per-token modulation."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dim: int,
+        n_heads: int,
+        norm_eps: float,
+        cross_attention_dim: Optional[int] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.attention = BriaFibo2Attention(dim, n_heads, dim // n_heads, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.feed_forward = BriaFibo2FeedForward(dim, (dim * 8 // 3) // 64 * 64)
+
+        self.attention_norm1 = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.ffn_norm1 = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.attention_norm2 = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.ffn_norm2 = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+
+        self.adaLN_modulation = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.Linear(min(dim, ADALN_EMBED_DIM), 4 * dim, bias=True)
+        )
+
+        if cross_attention_dim is not None:
+            self.cross_attn_norm1 = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+            self.cross_attention = BriaFibo2Attention(
+                dim, n_heads, dim // n_heads, kv_dim=cross_attention_dim, eps=norm_eps
+            )
+            self.cross_attn_norm2 = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+            self.cross_attn_gate = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(1))
+        else:
+            self.cross_attention = None
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        x: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor],
+        freqs_cis: Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+        adaln_input: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        noise_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        adaln_noisy: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        adaln_clean: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        encoder_hidden_states: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        encoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        seq_len = x.shape[1]
+
+        if noise_mask is not None:
+            # Per-token modulation: noisy and clean tokens get different values
+            mod_noisy = self.adaLN_modulation(adaln_noisy)
+            mod_clean = self.adaLN_modulation(adaln_clean)
+            (
+                scale_msa_noisy,
+                gate_msa_noisy,
+                scale_mlp_noisy,
+                gate_mlp_noisy,
+            ) = mod_noisy.chunk(4, dim=1)
+            (
+                scale_msa_clean,
+                gate_msa_clean,
+                scale_mlp_clean,
+                gate_mlp_clean,
+            ) = mod_clean.chunk(4, dim=1)
+
+            gate_msa_noisy, gate_mlp_noisy = (
+                gate_msa_noisy.tanh(),
+                gate_mlp_noisy.tanh(),
+            )
+            gate_msa_clean, gate_mlp_clean = (
+                gate_msa_clean.tanh(),
+                gate_mlp_clean.tanh(),
+            )
+            scale_msa_noisy, scale_mlp_noisy = (
+                1.0 + scale_msa_noisy,
+                1.0 + scale_mlp_noisy,
+            )
+            scale_msa_clean, scale_mlp_clean = (
+                1.0 + scale_msa_clean,
+                1.0 + scale_mlp_clean,
+            )
+
+            scale_msa = select_per_token(
+                scale_msa_noisy, scale_msa_clean, noise_mask, seq_len
+            )
+            scale_mlp = select_per_token(
+                scale_mlp_noisy, scale_mlp_clean, noise_mask, seq_len
+            )
+            gate_msa = select_per_token(
+                gate_msa_noisy, gate_msa_clean, noise_mask, seq_len
+            )
+            gate_mlp = select_per_token(
+                gate_mlp_noisy, gate_mlp_clean, noise_mask, seq_len
+            )
+        else:
+            # Global modulation: one value broadcast over the whole sequence
+            mod = self.adaLN_modulation(adaln_input)
+            scale_msa, gate_msa, scale_mlp, gate_mlp = mod.unsqueeze(1).chunk(4, dim=2)
+            gate_msa, gate_mlp = gate_msa.tanh(), gate_mlp.tanh()
+            scale_msa, scale_mlp = 1.0 + scale_msa, 1.0 + scale_mlp
+
+        attn_out = self.attention(
+            self.attention_norm1(x) * scale_msa,
+            attention_mask=attn_mask,
+            freqs_cis=freqs_cis,
+        )
+        x = x + gate_msa * self.attention_norm2(attn_out)
+
+        if self.cross_attention is not None:
+            cross_out = self.cross_attention(
+                self.cross_attn_norm1(x),
+                encoder_hidden_states=encoder_hidden_states,
+                attention_mask=encoder_attention_mask,
+            )
+            x = x + self.cross_attn_gate.tanh() * self.cross_attn_norm2(cross_out)
+
+        x = x + gate_mlp * self.ffn_norm2(
+            self.feed_forward(self.ffn_norm1(x) * scale_mlp)
+        )
+        return x
+

+class BriaFibo2PerceiverLayer(nn.Module):
+    """Gist tokens read the text bundle, then each other, then an FFN."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, dim: int, n_heads: int, cross_attention_dim: int, norm_eps: float
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.cross_attn_norm = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.cross_attention = BriaFibo2Attention(
+            dim, n_heads, dim // n_heads, kv_dim=cross_attention_dim, eps=norm_eps
+        )
+        self.self_attn_norm = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.self_attention = BriaFibo2Attention(
+            dim, n_heads, dim // n_heads, eps=norm_eps
+        )
+        self.ffn_norm = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+        self.ffn = BriaFibo2FeedForward(dim, (dim * 8 // 3) // 64 * 64)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        latents: torch.Tensor,
+        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        encoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        latents = latents + self.cross_attention(
+            self.cross_attn_norm(latents),
+            encoder_hidden_states=encoder_hidden_states,
+            attention_mask=encoder_attention_mask,
+        )
+        latents = latents + self.self_attention(
+            self.self_attn_norm(latents), attention_mask=attention_mask
+        )
+        latents = latents + self.ffn(self.ffn_norm(latents))
+        return latents
+

+class BriaFibo2PerceiverResampler(nn.Module):
+    """Squeezes the text bundle into ``num_gist_tokens`` gist tokens."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        dim: int,
+        n_heads: int,
+        cross_attention_dim: int,
+        num_queries: int,
+        num_layers: int,
+        norm_eps: float,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.latent_queries = nn.Parameter(torch.randn(num_queries, dim) * 0.02)
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                BriaFibo2PerceiverLayer(dim, n_heads, cross_attention_dim, norm_eps)
+                for _ in range(num_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.norm_out = BriaFibo2RMSNorm(dim, eps=norm_eps)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        num_gist_tokens: int,
+        encoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch_size = encoder_hidden_states.shape[0]
+        latents = (
+            self.latent_queries[:num_gist_tokens]
+            .unsqueeze(0)
+            .expand(batch_size, -1, -1)
+        )
+        for layer in self.layers:
+            latents = layer(
+                latents, encoder_hidden_states, encoder_attention_mask, attention_mask
+            )
+        return self.norm_out(latents)
+
+
+class BriaFibo2FinalLayer(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, out_channels: int) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.norm_final = nn.LayerNorm(hidden_size, elementwise_affine=False, eps=1e-6)
+        self.linear = nn.Linear(hidden_size, out_channels, bias=True)
+        self.adaLN_modulation = nn.Sequential(
+            nn.SiLU(),
+            nn.Linear(min(hidden_size, ADALN_EMBED_DIM), hidden_size, bias=True),
+        )
+
+    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, c: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        scale = 1.0 + self.adaLN_modulation(c)
+        return self.linear(self.norm_final(x) * scale.unsqueeze(1))
+

+class BriaFibo2Transformer2DModel(CachableDiT):
+    param_names_mapping = BriaFibo2DitConfig().arch_config.param_names_mapping
+    reverse_param_names_mapping = (
+        BriaFibo2DitConfig().arch_config.reverse_param_names_mapping
+    )
+    # Single-GPU implementation: nothing is sharded, so FSDP has no layer groups
+    _fsdp_shard_conditions: list = []
+    _compile_conditions: list = []
+    packed_modules_mapping: dict = {}
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        config: BriaFibo2DitConfig,
+        hf_config: dict[str, Any],
+        quant_config: Optional[QuantizationConfig] = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__(config=config, hf_config=hf_config)
+
+        arch_config = self.config
+        self.dim = arch_config.dim
+        self.in_channels = arch_config.in_channels
+        self.out_channels = arch_config.out_channels
+        self.patch_size = arch_config.patch_size
+        self.n_heads = arch_config.num_attention_heads
+        self.hidden_size = arch_config.dim
+        self.num_attention_heads = arch_config.num_attention_heads
+        self.num_channels_latents = arch_config.in_channels
+        self.gradient_checkpointing = False
+
+        self.x_embedder = nn.Linear(
+            self.patch_size * self.patch_size * self.in_channels, self.dim, bias=True
+        )
+        self.t_embedder = BriaFibo2TimestepEmbedder(
+            min(self.dim, ADALN_EMBED_DIM), mid_size=1024
+        )
+        self.rope_embedder = RopeEmbedder(
+            theta=arch_config.rope_theta,
+            axes_dims=list(arch_config.axes_dims),
+            axes_lens=list(arch_config.axes_lens),
+        )
+
+        self.noise_refiner = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                BriaFibo2TransformerBlock(self.dim, self.n_heads, arch_config.norm_eps)
+                for _ in range(arch_config.n_refiner_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.perceiver = BriaFibo2PerceiverResampler(
+            self.dim,
+            self.n_heads,
+            arch_config.cap_feat_dim,
+            arch_config.max_num_gist_tokens,
+            arch_config.perceiver_num_layers,
+            arch_config.norm_eps,
+        )
+        injection_layer_ids = set(arch_config.injection_layer_ids)
+        self.layers = nn.ModuleList(
+            [
+                BriaFibo2TransformerBlock(
+                    self.dim,
+                    self.n_heads,
+                    arch_config.norm_eps,
+                    cross_attention_dim=(
+                        arch_config.cap_feat_dim
+                        if layer_id in injection_layer_ids
+                        else None
+                    ),
+                )
+                for layer_id in range(arch_config.num_layers)
+            ]
+        )
+        self.final_layer = BriaFibo2FinalLayer(
+            self.dim, self.patch_size * self.patch_size * self.out_channels
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def create_coordinate_grid(
+        size: Sequence[int],
+        start: Optional[Sequence[int]] = None,
+        device: Optional[torch.device] = None,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        if start is None:
+            start = (0 for _ in size)
+        axes = [
+            torch.arange(x0, x0 + span, dtype=torch.int32, device=device)
+            for x0, span in zip(start, size)
+        ]
+        grids = torch.meshgrid(axes, indexing="ij")
+        return torch.stack(grids, dim=-1)
+
+    def _patchify(self, latents: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """2x2 latent patches become tokens, features ordered (channel, dy, dx)."""
+        batch_size, channels, height, width = latents.shape
+        patch_size = self.patch_size
+        latents = latents.view(
+            batch_size,
+            channels,
+            height // patch_size,
+            patch_size,
+            width // patch_size,
+            patch_size,
+        )
+        return latents.permute(0, 2, 4, 1, 3, 5).reshape(
+            batch_size, (height // patch_size) * (width // patch_size), -1
+        )
+
+    def _unpatchify(
+        self, tokens: torch.Tensor, height: int, width: int
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        batch_size = tokens.shape[0]
+        patch_size = self.patch_size
+        height_tokens, width_tokens = height // patch_size, width // patch_size
+        tokens = tokens.view(
+            batch_size,
+            height_tokens,
+            width_tokens,
+            self.out_channels,
+            patch_size,
+            patch_size,
+        )
+        return tokens.permute(0, 3, 1, 4, 2, 5).reshape(
+            batch_size, self.out_channels, height, width
+        )
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _unsqueeze_freqs(
+        freqs: Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor],
+    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+        cos, sin = freqs
+        return cos.unsqueeze(0), sin.unsqueeze(0)
+
+    def forward(
+        self,
+        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        encoder_hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
+        timestep: torch.Tensor,
+        encoder_hidden_states_image: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        guidance: Any = None,
+        encoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
+        source_latents: Optional[Sequence[torch.Tensor]] = None,
+        **kwargs: Any,

+        Args:
+            hidden_states: clean-image latents being denoised, ``(B, in_channels, H, W)``.
+            encoder_hidden_states: ``(B, 1 + len(injection_layer_ids), text_len, cap_feat_dim)``.
+                Bundle 0 feeds the Perceiver, bundle k + 1 feeds injection block k.
+            timestep: noise level in ``[0, 1]``, 1 is pure noise.
+            encoder_attention_mask: bool mask ``(B, text_len)`` of the real text tokens.
+            source_latents: normalized latents of the images to edit, one
+                ``(B, in_channels, h, w)`` tensor per image, in order.

+        batch_size, _, height, width = hidden_states.shape

+        height_tokens, width_tokens = height // patch_size, width // patch_size
+        num_image_tokens = height_tokens * width_tokens
+        device = hidden_states.device
+
+        # 1. Timestep embeddings. Image tokens take the real timestep, the clean
+        # tokens (gist and context) take t = 0. `timestep` arrives in the
+        # scheduler's units, so rescale it into the [0, t_scale] domain the
+        # checkpoint's embedder was trained on.
+        timestep = timestep.to(hidden_states.dtype) * (

+        )

+        adaln_clean = self.t_embedder(torch.zeros_like(timestep))
+
+        # 2. Patchify the image and the context images, which share the patch
+        # embedding. The image sits on RoPE plane `max_num_gist_tokens + 1`
+        # whatever the gist count is; context image k sits on the k-th plane
+        # after it with its own rows and columns.
+        image_plane = arch_config.max_num_gist_tokens + 1
+        tokens = [self._patchify(hidden_states)]
+        ids = [
+            self.create_coordinate_grid(
+                (1, height_tokens, width_tokens), (image_plane, 0, 0), device
+            )
+        ]
+        for k, latents in enumerate(source_latents or []):
+            tokens.append(self._patchify(latents))
+            context_size = (
+                1,
+                latents.shape[2] // patch_size,
+                latents.shape[3] // patch_size,
+            )
+            ids.append(
+                self.create_coordinate_grid(
+                    context_size, (image_plane + k + 1, 0, 0), device
+                )
+            )
+        hidden_states = self.x_embedder(torch.cat(tokens, dim=1))
+        image_freqs = self._unsqueeze_freqs(
+            self.rope_embedder(torch.cat([grid.flatten(0, 2) for grid in ids]))
+        )
+
+        # 3. Noise refiner. With context images, only the image tokens are noisy.
+        refiner_noise_mask = None
+        if source_latents:
+            refiner_noise_mask = torch.zeros(
+                batch_size, hidden_states.shape[1], dtype=torch.long, device=device
+            )
+            refiner_noise_mask[:, :num_image_tokens] = 1
+        for block in self.noise_refiner:
+            hidden_states = block(
+                hidden_states,
+                None,
+                image_freqs,
+                adaln_input=adaln_noisy,
+                noise_mask=refiner_noise_mask,
+                adaln_noisy=adaln_noisy,
+                adaln_clean=adaln_clean,
+            )
+
+        # 4. Gist count per prompt from its text length, then the Perceiver turns
+        # the first bundle into gist tokens.
+        if encoder_attention_mask is not None:
+            text_lengths = encoder_attention_mask.sum(dim=1).tolist()
+        else:
+            text_lengths = [encoder_hidden_states.shape[2]] * batch_size
+        gist_counts = compute_gist_count(
+            text_lengths,
+            min_gist=arch_config.min_num_gist_tokens,
+            max_gist=arch_config.max_num_gist_tokens,
+            gist_step=arch_config.gist_step,
+            min_text_len=arch_config.gist_min_text_len,
+            max_text_len=arch_config.gist_max_text_len,
+        )
+        if min(gist_counts) != max(gist_counts):
+            # The per-prompt gist padding path reorders the sequence and needs a
+            # varlen-aware attention backend. Reject it instead of silently
+            # producing wrong tokens.
+            raise ValueError(
+                "BriaFibo2 does not support a batch whose prompts need different "
+                f"numbers of gist tokens yet (got {sorted(set(gist_counts))}). "
+                "Send these prompts as separate requests."
+            )
+        num_gist_tokens = gist_counts[0]
+        gist = self.perceiver(
+            encoder_hidden_states[:, 0], num_gist_tokens, encoder_attention_mask
+        )
+        gist_ids = self.create_coordinate_grid(
+            (num_gist_tokens, 1, 1), (1, 0, 0), device
+        ).flatten(0, 2)
+
+        # 5. One stream: gist tokens first, then the image, then the context,
+        # the order the model was trained with. Positions come from RoPE, so the
+        # order only affects float rounding.
+        gist_freqs = self._unsqueeze_freqs(self.rope_embedder(gist_ids))
+        image_start = num_gist_tokens
+        hidden_states = torch.cat([gist, hidden_states], dim=1)
+        freqs_cis = (
+            torch.cat([gist_freqs[0], image_freqs[0]], dim=1),
+            torch.cat([gist_freqs[1], image_freqs[1]], dim=1),

+            batch_size, hidden_states.shape[1], dtype=torch.long, device=device

+
+        # 6. The main blocks. Injection blocks read their own bundle.
+        bundle_index = {
+            layer_id: index + 1
+            for index, layer_id in enumerate(arch_config.injection_layer_ids)
+        }
+        for layer_id, block in enumerate(self.layers):

+                encoder_hidden_states[:, bundle_index[layer_id]]
+                if layer_id in bundle_index
+                else None
+            )
+            hidden_states = block(
+                hidden_states,
+                None,
+                freqs_cis,
+                noise_mask=noise_mask,
+                adaln_noisy=adaln_noisy,
+                adaln_clean=adaln_clean,
+                encoder_hidden_states=text,
+                encoder_attention_mask=encoder_attention_mask,
+            )
+
+        # 7. Final layer on the image tokens only, then unpatchify.
+        hidden_states = self.final_layer(
+            hidden_states[:, image_start : image_start + num_image_tokens], adaln_noisy
+        )
+        return self._unpatchify(hidden_states, height, width)

+def _load_key_shapes(path):
+    key_shapes = {}
+    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
+        for line in handle:
+            line = line.rstrip("\n")
+            if not line.strip():
+                continue
+            fields = line.split("\t")
+            if len(fields) < 3:
+                continue
+            name, shape = fields[0], fields[2]
+            dims = tuple(int(x) for x in shape.strip("[]").split(",") if x.strip())

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Numerical parity of the in-tree Fibo 2.0 transformer against diffusers.
+
+The strongest check we can run without weights or a GPU: build both models from
+a tiny configuration, copy diffusers' parameters into ours by name, and compare
+the outputs element-wise. Because the whole forward runs, a match proves far more
+than shape assertions - patchify feature order, the three-axis RoPE planes and
+rotation direction, per-token noisy/clean modulation, the Perceiver and gist
+construction, the injection blocks' cross-attention wiring, the ``[gist | image |
+context]`` token layout, the final layer reading only image tokens, and the
+unpatchify flip are all exercised at once.
+
+The test skips when the installed diffusers predates the model (0.42.0).
+"""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+diffusers = pytest.importorskip("diffusers")
+
+
+def _ref_transformer_cls():
+    try:
+        from diffusers.models.transformers.transformer_bria_fibo2 import (
+            BriaFibo2Transformer2DModel as RefModel,
+        )
+    except Exception as exc:  # model not in this diffusers version
+        pytest.skip(f"diffusers has no BriaFibo2 transformer: {exc}")
+    return RefModel
+
+
+# Small enough to run in a second on CPU, large enough to touch every branch:
+# one injection block, a Perceiver layer, a two-axis-value text length.
+REFERENCE_KWARGS = dict(
+    in_channels=32,
+    patch_size=2,
+    dim=64,
+    n_layers=3,
+    n_refiner_layers=1,
+    n_heads=2,
+    norm_eps=1e-5,
+    cap_feat_dim=48,
+    injection_layer_ids=(1,),
+    perceiver_num_layers=1,
+    min_num_gist_tokens=4,
+    max_num_gist_tokens=8,
+    gist_step=4,
+    gist_min_text_len=2,
+    gist_max_text_len=8,
+    rope_theta=256.0,
+    t_scale=1000.0,
+    # the sum must be the attention head dim, 64 // 2
+    axes_dims=(8, 12, 12),
+    axes_lens=(32, 8, 8),
+)
+
+
+def _build_reference():
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    return _ref_transformer_cls()(**REFERENCE_KWARGS).eval()
+
+
+def _build_ours():
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.bria_fibo2 import (
+        BriaFibo2DitConfig,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.bria_fibo2 import (
+        BriaFibo2Transformer2DModel,
+    )
+
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    config = BriaFibo2DitConfig()
+    arch = config.arch_config
+    # Reference convention: noise levels come in as [0, 1] and the embedder
+    # scales them by `t_scale` itself.
+    arch.scheduler_timesteps = 1.0
+    arch.in_channels = REFERENCE_KWARGS["in_channels"]
+    arch.patch_size = REFERENCE_KWARGS["patch_size"]
+    arch.dim = REFERENCE_KWARGS["dim"]
+    arch.num_layers = REFERENCE_KWARGS["n_layers"]
+    arch.n_refiner_layers = REFERENCE_KWARGS["n_refiner_layers"]
+    arch.num_attention_heads = REFERENCE_KWARGS["n_heads"]
+    arch.norm_eps = REFERENCE_KWARGS["norm_eps"]
+    arch.cap_feat_dim = REFERENCE_KWARGS["cap_feat_dim"]
+    arch.injection_layer_ids = REFERENCE_KWARGS["injection_layer_ids"]
+    arch.perceiver_num_layers = REFERENCE_KWARGS["perceiver_num_layers"]
+    arch.min_num_gist_tokens = REFERENCE_KWARGS["min_num_gist_tokens"]
+    arch.max_num_gist_tokens = REFERENCE_KWARGS["max_num_gist_tokens"]
+    arch.gist_step = REFERENCE_KWARGS["gist_step"]
+    arch.gist_min_text_len = REFERENCE_KWARGS["gist_min_text_len"]
+    arch.gist_max_text_len = REFERENCE_KWARGS["gist_max_text_len"]
+    arch.rope_theta = REFERENCE_KWARGS["rope_theta"]
+    arch.t_scale = REFERENCE_KWARGS["t_scale"]
+    arch.axes_dims = REFERENCE_KWARGS["axes_dims"]
+    arch.axes_lens = REFERENCE_KWARGS["axes_lens"]
+    arch.__post_init__()
+    return BriaFibo2Transformer2DModel(config, hf_config={}).eval()
+
+
+def _copy_reference_weights(reference, ours) -> None:
+    """Every reference key must exist with the same shape, then be copied over."""
+    ref_state = reference.state_dict()
+    our_state = ours.state_dict()
+
+    missing = sorted(set(ref_state) - set(our_state))
+    extra = sorted(set(our_state) - set(ref_state))
+    shape_mismatch = [
+        name
+        for name in set(ref_state) & set(our_state)
+        if ref_state[name].shape != our_state[name].shape
+    ]
+    assert not missing, f"reference keys absent from our model: {missing[:5]}"
+    assert not extra, f"our keys absent from the reference: {extra[:5]}"
+    assert not shape_mismatch, f"shape mismatches: {shape_mismatch[:5]}"
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for name, value in ref_state.items():
+            our_state[name].copy_(value)
+
+
+def _assert_parity(tag: str, expected: torch.Tensor, actual: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+    assert expected.shape == actual.shape, (tag, expected.shape, actual.shape)
+    expected_flat = expected.flatten().double()
+    actual_flat = actual.flatten().double()
+    max_abs = float((expected_flat - actual_flat).abs().max())
+    cosine = float(
+        (expected_flat * actual_flat).sum()
+        / (expected_flat.norm() * actual_flat.norm())
+    )
+    # fp32 on CPU: anything beyond rounding means a real semantic difference
+    assert max_abs < 1e-4, f"{tag}: max|delta| = {max_abs:.3e}"
+    assert cosine > 0.99999, f"{tag}: cosine = {cosine:.9f}"
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
+def models():
+    reference = _build_reference()
+    ours = _build_ours()
+    _copy_reference_weights(reference, ours)
+    return reference, ours
+
+
+def test_transformer_matches_diffusers_text_to_image(models):
+    reference, ours = models
+    batch, channels, height, width = 1, 32, 16, 16
+    text_len = 6
+    cap_feat_dim = REFERENCE_KWARGS["cap_feat_dim"]
+    num_bundles = len(REFERENCE_KWARGS["injection_layer_ids"]) + 1
+
+    torch.manual_seed(1)
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(batch, channels, height, width)
+    encoder_hidden_states = torch.randn(batch, num_bundles, text_len, cap_feat_dim)
+    attention_mask = torch.ones(batch, text_len, dtype=torch.bool)
+    timestep = torch.tensor([0.5])
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        expected = reference(
+            hidden_states,
+            timestep,
+            encoder_hidden_states,
+            encoder_attention_mask=attention_mask,
+            return_dict=False,
+        )[0]
+        actual = ours(
+            hidden_states,
+            encoder_hidden_states,
+            timestep,
+            encoder_attention_mask=attention_mask,
+        )
+    _assert_parity("text-to-image", expected, actual)
+
+
+def test_transformer_matches_diffusers_with_context_latents(models):
+    """Editing conditions on clean latents of reference images of any size."""
+    reference, ours = models
+    batch, channels, height, width = 1, 32, 16, 16
+    text_len = 6
+    cap_feat_dim = REFERENCE_KWARGS["cap_feat_dim"]
+    num_bundles = len(REFERENCE_KWARGS["injection_layer_ids"]) + 1
+
+    torch.manual_seed(2)
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(batch, channels, height, width)
+    encoder_hidden_states = torch.randn(batch, num_bundles, text_len, cap_feat_dim)
+    attention_mask = torch.ones(batch, text_len, dtype=torch.bool)
+    timestep = torch.tensor([0.5])
+    # two reference images, deliberately different sizes
+    reference_latents = [
+        torch.randn(batch, channels, height, width),
+        torch.randn(batch, channels, height // 2, width),
+    ]
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        expected = reference(
+            hidden_states,
+            timestep,
+            encoder_hidden_states,
+            encoder_attention_mask=attention_mask,
+            context_latents=reference_latents,
+            return_dict=False,
+        )[0]
+        actual = ours(
+            hidden_states,
+            encoder_hidden_states,
+            timestep,
+            encoder_attention_mask=attention_mask,
+            source_latents=reference_latents,
+        )
+    _assert_parity("editing", expected, actual)
+
+
+def test_transformer_matches_diffusers_without_text_mask(models):
+    """An unpadded prompt runs without a mask; gist count comes from the length."""
+    reference, ours = models
+    batch, channels, height, width = 1, 32, 16, 16
+    text_len = 5
+    cap_feat_dim = REFERENCE_KWARGS["cap_feat_dim"]
+    num_bundles = len(REFERENCE_KWARGS["injection_layer_ids"]) + 1
+
+    torch.manual_seed(3)
+    hidden_states = torch.randn(batch, channels, height, width)
+    encoder_hidden_states = torch.randn(batch, num_bundles, text_len, cap_feat_dim)
+    timestep = torch.tensor([0.25])
+
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        expected = reference(
+            hidden_states, timestep, encoder_hidden_states, return_dict=False
+        )[0]
+        actual = ours(hidden_states, encoder_hidden_states, timestep)
+    _assert_parity("no text mask", expected, actual)

Good catch — the mask was dead code, and the root cause is exactly what you describe: `InputValidationStage` calls `preprocess_condition_image` per image without the batch, so `getattr(batch, "mask", None)` could never see a request.

Fixed in the two commits on top. `preprocess_vae_image` is the hook that does receive the batch, and `InputValidationStage` runs it *before* the crop loop, so the greying now happens on the original image in the order training used:

- `[Feat] diffusion: plumb an optional repaint mask through the image edits API` — `POST /v1/images/edits` declared `mask` and dropped it; it is now saved and forwarded as `SamplingParams.mask_path` (per-request, like `image_path`), so a masked edit no longer silently degrades to a plain edit.
- `[Fix] diffusion/bria_fibo2: apply the request mask to the source image` — the greying moved to `preprocess_vae_image`; `preprocess_condition_image` is crop-only again. A mask with several reference images, or one whose size differs from its image, raises instead of being composited wrong. One detail only the real run surfaced: the hook has to leave `condition_image` as a list, because the stage iterates it immediately afterwards.

Verified on an H100 with the same inputs as the reference run (suitcase + mask, 4 steps, guidance 1.0): mean absolute change is **0.254 inside the mask vs 0.008 outside**, against the reference's 0.248 / 0.008 — the edit stays in the marked region and the rest is preserved. Locally: `184 passed, 3 skipped` across the five new test files plus the sampling-params / image-API suites, and `node --test docs/scripts/tests/*.test.mjs` 52/52.

Also rebased onto current `main`.
